capture: The unchanged Python application passed all 1,083 original tests under read-only instrumentation. Original-only additional captures cover effective validation, fabricated retrieval and protocol boundaries. All expected values were frozen before native comparison.
fixture_scope: 999 non-retrieval effective SDK calls, 6 resources, 34 prompts, 241 retrieval cases plus 3 large-catalogue provenance cases and 1,175 JSON-RPC replies across 34 sessions. Complete results/refusals are compared, with only the identities and provenance allowances in NATIVE.md. Additional negative schema, extension and CLI assertions are in boundary_contracts.rs. This does not assert every original test is covered.
refreeze: Refrozen against the Python server at the base above. Transforms were named and counted, the scoring cases re-captured from tool_selection.py, and freshness-contracts.json captured over stdio from the Python server. oracle_sha256 records the first capture's raw files, which are not in this repository.
